commit_message: [GlobalOptimization] Rewrite QDQ contractions into integer math (#24902) Rewrites contractions over `iree_linalg_ext.dequantize_affine` operands into integer contractions, integer zero-point corrections, and floating-point scaling. The transformation uses indexing maps and iterator types to handle named and generic contractions, including convolutions. It reduces in integer arithmetic over dimensions where quantization parameters are invariant. For blockwise quantization, it computes integer partial results, applies each block's correction and scales, then accumulates across blocks in floating point. Zero-point correction terms are built as separate computations so constant terms can be evaluated independently. Corrections are applied before conversion to floating point. Scaling and accumulation use at least f32, preserving wider scale or output types and narrowing only the final result. The rewrite requires a plain multiply-add body, zero initialization, and positive static integer reduction extents whose products and corrections fit in signed i32. Unsupported cases retain the original computation. The pass is enabled by default; reassociation changes floating-point rounding. It can be disabled with `--iree-global-opt-enable-qdq-to-integer-math=false`. Builds on the [affine QDQ operations PR #24901](https://github.com/iree-org/iree/pull/24901) and implements the contraction rewrite portion of [Linalg(_ext) native QDQ #24862](https://github.com/iree-org/iree/issues/24862). --- Stack created with GitHub Stacks CLI • Give Feedback 💬 --------- Signed-off-by: Thomas Ziereis Signed-off-by: Florian Walbroel Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) Co-authored-by: Florian Walbroel

commit_message:
[LinalgExt] Canonicalize zero zero-points in affine QDQ ops (#24905)

Canonicalizes `iree_linalg_ext.quantize_affine` and
`iree_linalg_ext.dequantize_affine` by removing a zero-point operand
when its constant value is zero in every element. The operations then
expose symmetric quantization directly, allowing decomposition to omit
zero-point arithmetic and the integer-contraction rewrite to skip the
corresponding correction terms.

Handles scalar constants, tensor splats, dense tensors, and
resource-backed tensor constants. Removing the operand also removes its
indexing map and `zp_unsigned` attribute while preserving the remaining
operation attributes. Tests cover these constant representations,
nonzero values that must remain, and preservation of the operation's
other parameters.

Builds on #24902 in the affine QDQ stack. Part of #24862.

so dynamic i32 scatter indices do not require an unbounded temporary.

commit_message:
[LinalgExt] Canonicalize zero zero-points in affine QDQ ops (#24905)

Canonicalizes `iree_linalg_ext.quantize_affine` and
`iree_linalg_ext.dequantize_affine` by removing a zero-point operand
when its constant value is zero in every element. The operations then
expose symmetric quantization directly, allowing decomposition to omit
zero-point arithmetic and the integer-contraction rewrite to skip the
corresponding correction terms.

Handles scalar constants, tensor splats, dense tensors, and
resource-backed tensor constants. Removing the operand also removes its
indexing map and `zp_unsigned` attribute while preserving the remaining
operation attributes. Tests cover these constant representations,
nonzero values that must remain, and preservation of the operation's
other parameters.

Builds on #24902 in the affine QDQ stack. Part of #24862.

Signed-off-by: Thomas Ziereis <ziereis@roofline.ai>

commit_message:
[GlobalOptimization] Fold empty-set reductions to their init operand.

Reductions over a zero-sized dimension (e.g. input shape 2x0x4 -> 2x1x4)
lower to a linalg.generic with a 0-extent input, which crashes codegen
tiling (computeAllSliceParameters assertion).

When the reduced dimension has size 0, no input element is ever combined,
so the result of the reduction is exactly its init operand. This adds a
pattern in RemoveZeroExtentTensors that replaces such a reduction with its
existing init operand, so the 0-extent generic never reaches codegen.

Forwarding the init (instead of synthesizing a linalg.fill of the reduction
identity) preserves the semantics of any initial accumulator value, including
non-identity ones, and avoids materializing a new fill. For ONNX empty-set
reductions the init already carries the identity (sum -> 0, prod -> 1), so the
observable result is unchanged.

Adds lit coverage for the rewrite:
  - a reduction with a non-identity initial accumulator (init preserved),
  - dynamic output dimensions.

Fixes 8 onnx_ops *_empty_set cases:
test_reduce_sum_empty_set
test_reduce_sum_square_empty_set
test_reduce_sum_square_empty_set_expanded
test_reduce_l1_empty_set
test_reduce_l1_empty_set_expanded
test_reduce_l2_empty_set
test_reduce_log_sum_empty_set
test_reduce_log_sum_exp_empty_set

Reductions over a zero-sized dimension (e.g. input shape 2x0x4 -> 2x1x4)
lower to a linalg.generic with a 0-extent input, which crashes codegen
tiling (computeAllSliceParameters assertion).

non-identity ones, and avoids materializing a new fill. For ONNX empty-set

commit_message: [GlobalOptimization] Rewrite QDQ contractions into integer math (#24902) Rewrites contractions over `iree_linalg_ext.dequantize_affine` operands into integer contractions, integer zero-point corrections, and floating-point scaling. The transformation uses indexing maps and iterator types to handle named and generic contractions, including convolutions. It reduces in integer arithmetic over dimensions where quantization parameters are invariant. For blockwise quantization, it computes integer partial results, applies each block's correction and scales, then accumulates across blocks in floating point. Zero-point correction terms are built as separate computations so constant terms can be evaluated independently. Corrections are applied before conversion to floating point. Scaling and accumulation use at least f32, preserving wider scale or output types and narrowing only the final result. The rewrite requires a plain multiply-add body, zero initialization, and positive static integer reduction extents whose products and corrections fit in signed i32. Unsupported cases retain the original computation. The pass is enabled by default; reassociation changes floating-point rounding. It can be disabled with `--iree-global-opt-enable-qdq-to-integer-math=false`. Builds on the [affine QDQ operations PR #24901](https://github.com/iree-org/iree/pull/24901) and implements the contraction rewrite portion of [Linalg(_ext) native QDQ #24862](https://github.com/iree-org/iree/issues/24862). --- Stack created with GitHub Stacks CLI • Give Feedback 💬 --------- Signed-off-by: Thomas Ziereis Signed-off-by: Florian Walbroel Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) Co-authored-by: Florian Walbroel
